name: AUTH-DELEGATION
status: Historical unfrozen G6 proposal; no implementation or issuer existed at that stage. Superseded by auth-delegation-v1.json and delegation-runtime-v1.json; independent Knowledge and Agent authority and receiver integration remain pending.
fundamental: Issuer knode-user holds signing key; single target audience; token_use=delegation. Validate algorithm, trusted kid, issuer, expiry and token type.
An authenticated machine service token and a valid user token or independently verifiable parent grant are both required. act.sub is the actual authenticated calling service, not a body claim.

sub/user_scope/sid derive from verified user or durable parent grant. Check sid/sub/scope against current authoritative session on issuance and every protected use; unavailable authority is 503, revoked or mismatched is 401.

Permissions and resource constraints are the intersection of user authority, authenticated service grants, parent authority and target operation; none may expand. Effective expiry never exceeds parent authority and session expiry.

creation.proof: Knowledge must supply an authenticated durable authorization/registration proof binding the request to the authenticated user's authorized knowledgeBaseId and idempotency identity. The issuer cannot trust self-reported IDs; no runId exists yet.

execution.proof: Agent must supply authenticated durable registration/lease evidence mapping the completed creation grant to runId, current controlEpoch, worker and expiry. The issuer or target must check current authority and epoch against that source; stale epochs are denied even with an unexpired token.

checks: Verify actual Agent machine identity and permitted exchange chain.
Verify parent signature, audience for its current holder, lifetime, durable grant, current sid, runId, controlEpoch and resource bindings.
Issue only knode-knowledge audience and reduced operations/resources; act.sub becomes the actual Agent caller.
Never derive a new valid grant from an expired, revoked, exhausted or superseded parent.

manualContinue.requires: Explicit action by the authenticated user under a currently valid new sid; recheck knowledge access and obtain fresh durable authorization.
manualContinue.prohibits: Do not reuse or refresh the expired/revoked parent or silently turn WAITING_INPUT into an answer.
manualContinue.epoch: Agent authority must atomically advance and attest the new controlEpoch and invalidate the previous execution lease.

revokedCheckpoint.purpose: After revocation, permit only one already-started safe-step checkpoint to be persisted and paused; no new work, reads, user output, privilege expansion or completion.
revokedCheckpoint.proof: Agent's durable step-start record, worker identity, runId, epoch, bounded checkpoint scope and one-use/short lifetime must be verified independently. A user-delegation sid bypass must not confer general API access; target must enforce the one narrow capability.

user: Authoritative session validation and aud-bound delegation signer; current user and machine verification; durable revocation check.
knowledge: Durable authorization and creation registration proof tied to user, knowledgeBaseId, clientRequestId and permissible operations; resource revocation lookup.
agent: Durable run registration, current controlEpoch, worker lease, step-start and one-use checkpoint proof; atomic epoch advancement and revocation.
shared: Frozen proof formats, verification keys, audience and permissions matrix, expiry/replay/error semantics, event consumer deduplication and failure policy.

openDecisions: Who owns and signs persistent grants and registration proofs; exact APIs and revocation consistency guarantees.
Checkpoint capability replay protection and the transaction boundary for step completion versus revocation.
Allowed delegation chains, maximum lifetimes and operation-specific resource scopes.
nonGoals: This historical G6 candidate did not implement a delegation endpoint, proof service, Agent state machine or consumer. See auth-delegation-v1.json and delegation-runtime-v1.json for the current User-side scope and remaining integration.
